senses.gloss: m. (קזז, cmp. גזז a. Arab. ḳazz salire) jumper, runner.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:2:2">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵃ</cite> top <he>כהדין מקזנה</he> (corr. acc.) the torches were moved (v. Mish.

<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 2:4">ib. II, 4</cite>) in the manner of the runner (in zigzag).—Pl. <he>מַקְזָזֵי</he>. Pesik. B’shall. p. 84ᵃ <he>מַקְזָזוֹי מן קדמוי וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>מקקוזיי</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 225">Yalk. Ex. 225</cite> <cite ref="M02407"><he>מקזווי</he></cite>, corr. acc.) his runners before him, his runners behind him (<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:12:1">Cant. R. to IV, 12</cite> <he>ועבדים מהלכין אחריו</he>).
